notes: Landing hero decomposition from supplied Fairlend financing-route mockup. Crops are reference-only and must not be shipped as production image assets.

assets.label: Financing route editorial header
assets.role: Top hero header with section numbering, brand lockup, and broker descriptor
assets.rationale: Mostly typography, dividers, border rules, and brand text that should remain editable and responsive.

implementation.acceptance: Preserves editorial index styling, rule dividers, Fairlend brand scale, and responsive compression.

assets.label: Financing route copy and application form
assets.role: Left hero content, title, description, and address CTA
assets.rationale: Live marketing copy and form control should be implemented with React, existing inputs, and address autocomplete primitives.

implementation.acceptance: Uses existing local input/button/form primitives where possible and preserves headline hierarchy, orange accent rule, and bordered application panel.

assets.label: Isometric financing process illustration
assets.role: Primary hero illustration showing permit, acquisition, construction, and completion route
assets.rationale: Complex isometric drawing with skyline, papers, buildings, crane, shadows, grid texture, and route line is better generated as a standalone raster asset.

generation.prompt: Reference image only: generate a new standalone transparent PNG asset of a premium editorial isometric construction-financing route illustration. Cream drafting-paper base plane with faint grid, Toronto skyline sketched in light graphite at the back, four-step orange route line connecting a permit application clipboard, a single-family house acquisition vignette, a mid-rise construction site with tower crane, and a completed boutique apartment building with shield/check medallion. Fine ink outlines, muted warm greys, dark green details, small burnt-orange numbered markers, soft shadows, high-end brokerage presentation style, clean cutout edges, no UI frame, no text that needs to remain readable.
generation.negative_prompt: Do not include Fairlend logo, header bars, form inputs, browser chrome, watermarks, blurry text, cropped edges, photorealistic people, or a full webpage screenshot.

assets.label: Small illustration CTA form
assets.role: Secondary address CTA over the process illustration
assets.rationale: Text, address input, icon, border, and submit button should remain accessible live UI layered over the illustration.

implementation.acceptance: Composable compact variant of the main application form with live placeholder text and keyboard-focus states.

assets.label: Financing route credibility stats strip
assets.role: Bottom FSRA, experience, financing, and location proof points
assets.rationale: Icon plus text proof points and separators are simple live UI and should adapt from local icon/stat patterns.

implementation.acceptance: Uses lucide/local icons, stable columns, accessible text, and responsive wrapping without layout shift.
